lines.zh: 我贴着地面爬，背上的刺晃。
lines.en: I crawl close to the ground, back spikes swaying.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走，很慢，很谨慎。
lines.en: I walk step by step, slow and wary.
I head for the mud.
I cross the grass, and it lies flat.
I scrape past the right side of the stone.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，不想被看见。
lines.en: I keep low, not wanting to be seen.
Two steps, then I stop to listen.
My tail drags and sweeps up dust.
I move slowly toward the water.

lines.zh: 我身上有苔，走起来沙沙响。
lines.en: Moss on my back whispers as I walk.

lines.zh: 我从泥里出来，身上全是土。
lines.en: I come out of the mud, covered in dirt.
I walk with my neck drawn in.
I crawl a stretch along the riverbank.

lines.zh: 我走两步，扭头看看身后。
lines.en: I take two steps and twist my head to look back.

lines.zh: 我半截身子陷在凉泥里。
lines.en: Half of me sinks into the cool mud.
I rolled once in the mud.

lines.zh: 我背上的刺尖有点钝了。
lines.en: The tips of my back spikes have dulled.
At a sound, I shrink down.
I'm shy; don't look at me.
I rest my head on the soil; it's cool.

lines.zh: 有人靠近，我就往土里钻。
lines.en: When someone comes near, I burrow down into the dirt.

lines.zh: 苔藓在我背上长得很厚。
lines.en: The moss on my back has grown thick.
I count the grass nearby.
I hold my breath and pass for a clod of earth.
I'm sunning myself; it's warm.

lines.zh: 我身上的雪化了，湿湿的。
lines.en: The snow on me has melted; I'm wet.

lines.zh: 我抬了一下头，又埋回去。
lines.en: I lift my head once, then bury it again.
When I breathe out, the soil stirs.

lines.zh: 我记得化石里的那种黑暗。
lines.en: I remember the dark inside the fossil.
My legs are short; I can't go fast.

lines.zh: 我在听有没有更大的东西。
lines.en: I'm listening for something bigger.

lines.zh: 我把四条短腿收进壳下。
lines.en: I tuck my four short legs under my shell.
Are you looking at me? I'll hide.

lines.zh: 我背上的刺不是给你玩的。
lines.en: The spikes on my back aren't toys.
Don't come too close; I'm timid.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，藏在土里。
lines.en: I lower my head into the soil.
Do you have shears?
My moss has been trimmed a few times.
Are you going to clean the mud off me?
I back away one slow step.
Stand still, and I'll come out.
I smell soil on your hands.

lines.zh: 你咧着嘴，我缩了缩脖子。
lines.en: You bare your teeth; I shrink my neck.
I can see you even from in the soil.
I sink into the soil, only spikes showing.
I burrow into the mud, hurriedly.
One of my back spikes broke.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，土落了一地。
lines.en: I shudder, and soil scatters.
I back off two steps, neck tucked.
I don't cry out; I only hide.
I press the wound into the soil.
There's blood on my moss.
I slowly lie down and recover.
I'm alive; only shaken.
That tender leaf looks all right.

lines.zh: 你把叶子放下，我就过去。
lines.en: Set the leaf down and I'll come.
The smell of mud calms me.
I shift one step toward that green.
Somewhere wet is better.
Is that moss in your hand?
I stretch my neck out slowly.
I smell fresh grass.
I'm coming closer; don't move.
That bite of grass is close enough.
You touch my spikes; I flinch.

lines.zh: 我被撞得歪了，慢慢爬开。
lines.en: I'm knocked askew and crawl away.

lines.zh: 我从你小腿旁边蹭过去。
lines.en: I squeeze past your shin.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我立刻往下埋。
lines.en: We collide, and I bury myself at once.
Your foot lands on my tail.
I press to the ground and freeze.
I retreat into the mud, only my back showing.
I dodge into a root.

lines.zh: 我们碰了一下，没伤到谁。
lines.en: We bump once; no harm.
You step back; only then do I emerge.
Another is rolling in the mud too.

lines.zh: 她背上那对刺比我的钝。
lines.en: The spines on her back are duller than mine.
We lie buried side by side.
The moss on her back is greener.
We come closer slowly, in no rush.
She rests her head on my shell.

lines.zh: 我们一起在太阳下趴着。
lines.en: We lie in the sun together.
She's shyer than I am.
We both rolled in the mud.
Two clumsy things, hiding together.

lines.zh: 我把叶子拖进泥里慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I drag a leaf into the mud and chew it slowly.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的锹推到一边。
lines.en: I push your dropped shovel aside.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块苔藓，闻了闻。
lines.en: I pick up a bit of moss and sniff.

lines.zh: 我咬住一根草，拔了下来。
lines.en: I bite a blade of grass and pull it up.
I push a stone out of the mud.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的剪刀，看了看。
lines.en: I pick up your shears and look at them.
I pile leaves at my burrow.

lines.zh: 我拖着一根树枝，拖不动。
lines.en: I drag a branch and can't move it.
I push a snowball to your feet.

lines.zh: 我拾起一小块化石，含在嘴里。
lines.en: I pick up a fossil shard and hold it in my mouth.
There's a sound over there; I don't like it.
I raise my head and pick that way.
The spikes on my back have risen.
It's too big; I'll hide first.
I shift toward the mud pit.
It's not here for grass.
I flatten low, ready to bolt.
There's no cover that way.
I turn toward the roots.
I've picked where to bury myself.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿地往树根退。
lines.en: I back toward the roots a step at a time.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过去，刺朝外。
lines.en: I turn sideways, spikes outward.
One more step and I'll run.
I dare only look at its toes.
I shift toward the nearest mud pit.
When I stop, its feet stop too.
I hear it shift its weight.
I lower my head and pose as a stone.
Five steps to the mud pit.
It circles right; I go left.
I drive my back spikes into it.

lines.zh: 我的尾锤扫在它的脚上。
lines.en: My tail club sweeps across its foot.

lines.zh: 我撞开它的腿，往泥里跑。
lines.en: I butt its leg and run for the mud.
I bite its trouser hem.

lines.zh: 这一下没什么力，但我尽力了。
lines.en: There wasn't much force, but I tried.
I turn, and the spikes rake.
I shove it off and retreat myself.

lines.zh: 我撞在它膝盖上，弹回来。
lines.en: I hit its knee and bounce back.
I butt with my head; it's hard.
I turn and run without looking back.

lines.zh: 我顶开湿土，甩落一身泥。
lines.en: I push up through the wet soil and shake off the mud.
I lay in the fossil a long time.
The slime brought me back.
I lift my eyelids and smell wet mud.
It's warmer here than in the fossil.
First I bury myself.
The spikes on my back are still soft.
Leaves and mud; good.
I hear running water.
I poke out my head and take in the surroundings.
Two steps and I already want to hide.
Grass nearby; I'll take a bite.
I settle myself under a tree.
My body is still stiff.
At the heat, I dig deeper.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，滚到沟里。
lines.en: I slide off a slope into a ditch.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我拼命往上爬。
lines.en: Water pours in; I claw upward.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀了个肚皮朝天。
lines.en: The blast flips me belly-up.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我的壳边上，很疼。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell's edge, sharp.
A light pins me; I can't move.
I haven't had grass in ages.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，刺都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back; my spikes light up.
There's no soil here to grip.
